text_block_list.text: Голд Шип's results are fantastic!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If she can keep this up, she'll be ready
for the
Classics next year for sure!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thanks! You gotta admit, I was savory
enough to
make a smoked ray's fin
jealous, eh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: To think, now I've conquered the land and the sea!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Since the race was only on land, it's hard
to
agree...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I guess that means that's it for the
Twinkle Series,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Now I have nowhere to channel my
burning
competitive spirit...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Nothing I can do about it, though. Might
as well
get a job putting those fake
decorative leaf
thingies in supermarket
sushi boxes.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Oh, but filling those fish-shaped
containers with
soy sauce sounds fun
too...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The real challenge of the Twinkle Series
is in the
Classics that still lie ahead of us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I open my mouth to tell her there are
still plenty
of intense races left, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hm? Hmmm?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Whoooaaah!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Holy fish and chips! Check this out,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You won't believe it, but a new chapter
of the
Book of Secrets just dropped!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Don't you remember? It's the book
detailing the
Umamusume utopia, Eden.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Gulp... All right, let's take a look...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
"O Umamusume in search of Eden, go,
and face
your greatest adversary in the
Classics."
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
"Only then will your path to Eden be
revealed..."
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Is that the coolest thing or what?! That is so awesome!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: I'd totally forgotten about Eden!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
So, I just have to beat the big shots in
the
Classics, right?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'm about to burst from
excitement right
now!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Follow me, Trainer! I gotta start
practicing my
Flaming Death Fist ASAP!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The reason for her sudden surge in
enthusiasm is
beyond me, but I'm just
pleased she's so excited
for the Classics.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
